fields.summary: TRU men's volleyball head coach since 2005. 2024 U Sports Men's Volleyball Coach of the Year.
fields.bio:
Pat Hennelly is the President of Tumbleweeds Volleyball Club.

He has coached university volleyball since 1995: at UBC, as an assistant at Northern Arizona University, and as head coach of the TRU men's team since 2005. He was named 2024 U Sports Men's Volleyball Coach of the Year. He was also named 2024 Canada West Men's Volleyball Coach of the Year.

[Pat's coaching role with Tumbleweeds teams: TBC]

hero.hero_heading: Straight answers, including the hard ones.
hero.hero_text: We are a new club. Here is what you are probably wondering, answered plainly.

items.question: Pat coaches the university team. Is he coaching my kid?
items.answer: [Pat's exact role on the court: TBC]. We will state it plainly here before tryouts, so you know who is in the gym with your athlete.

items.question: You are brand new. Why risk a season?
items.answer: You are right, this is our first season. So we are putting the facts up front: who coaches, what it costs, and how we keep kids safe. You can decide with everything in front of you. New clubs also serve a one-year probation with Volleyball BC. [Date the coach list and fees are posted: TBC]

items.question: What does it cost, really?
items.answer: Club fee [$TBC], coach and travel fees about [$TBC], total about [$TBC] for [age group]. We will show what is included and what is not, and the refund policy: [Refund policy TBC].

items.question: How much travel is there?
items.answer: [Number] tournaments, in [places TBC]. Hotels [included / not included TBC]. We will list every tournament and where it is before you sign.

items.question: Will my kid play?
items.answer: [Club playing-time approach: TBC]. We will write down how playing time works for each age group before tryouts.

items.question: Who do I call if something goes wrong?
items.answer: Talk to your coach first. If you need someone outside the club, call [named contact TBC]. For concerns about abuse or maltreatment, anyone in Canada can call the Abuse-Free Sport Helpline: 1-888-83SPORT (77678).
